name: plaiiin-app-capture
description: See the Mac you are working on. `app-capture` photographs a window, a rectangle or a web page on request — a real screen capture, refused rather than faked when it cannot be taken. Covers staging a window (hide the rest, centre, fit, exact size, restored afterwards), poster backdrops that are drawn rather than photographed, and why a refusal beats a picture of the wallpaper.
